subject: integration
name: Orivon test library: add
summary: A fixture of Orivon's own tests (lib.add@1.0.0): a WebAssembly module of 41 bytes, written out byte for byte, with no imports and one export, add(i32, i32). It can reach nothing, holds no state and asks for no grant. Open source, and the bytes are the source. Judged here by its publisher.
